method: Two synthetic suites with isolated SQLite Memory and Chroma RAG.
Fixture embeddings and a fixed Chief answer adapter; answer generation was not measured.
Orchestration modes used the same case labels and routing. Luna ran separately over the same data hashes.
The holdout was authored for this task separately from the existing validation suite; no independent human review.
Horizon scores were advisory. GPT-5.6 Luna used the legacy strict boolean assessment through LAEW ChatGPT OAuth.
CPU and RAM are Docker Desktop samples of the Horizon container. Hosted model resource use was unavailable.
